title: Simultaneous strength and ductility improvement of As-cast HfMoTaTiZrCrx refractory high entropy alloys via Cr addition
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38346-38353
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05085E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Man Xu, Lei Bai, Xiang Guo, Huihui Wang, Kyungjun Lee, Zijian Geng, Junjun Wang
Simultaneous strength-ductility enhancement of HfMoTaTiZrCrx RHEAs was attained. The optimized HfMoTaTiZrCr0.75 achieves σ0.2 of 1982.7 MPa and εf of 12.4%, representing an outstanding strength among as-cast RHEAs with comparable ductility.
